mission_priority: XRP intelligence and measured prediction-engine mastery
foundation: Barrot V3 execution, security, verification and preservation

confirmed_main_findings.detail: The current public tree contains dump.json (353950 bytes, blob f5397bc2868a0a4a7f832b7f33c7624226f6a08a) and dump.md (296527 bytes, blob d2ccf44fdb0331b8dd0271bb1ca5d9bc7e27581e). The manually dispatchable workflow grants contents:write, references DATABRICKS_TOKEN, queries workspace.barrot.brain, and commits/pushes the generated corpus. Individual record contents were not inspected; sensitivity is unclassified.
Manual dispatch exposes mode=all, max_prs=0 (unlimited), dry_run=false by default, contents:write and pull-requests:write, and includes branch-update/merge logic.
A 15-minute schedule and manual dispatch grant contents:write and actions:write; the workflow commits schedule_queue.jsonl to main and pushes.

Scheduled, workflow_run and manual triggers run with contents:write and commit/push generated analysis files to main. The latest main commit 60aef00405f26badabd4ac15807df163756204cc was authored 2026-11-03T06:51:35Z, message Cross-analysis refresh [skip ci], and changed only ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json generated_at.

proposed_changes: Disable public brain-corpus workflow with empty permissions and an inert job.
Replace the Databricks exporter with a no-network/no-write disabled entry point.
Remove the two generated corpus dumps from the proposed current tree without rewriting Git history.
Disable the broad manual merge queue and remove all mutation/merge capability.
Disable Scheduler Tick until a separately reviewed durable non-main state store and approval model exist.
Restrict local scheduler dispatch to two input-free read-only validation workflows.
Make Cross Analysis contents-read only, remove all git commit/push behavior, and retain bounded 30-day workflow artifacts.
Add four regression suites and register them in core CI.

verification.branch_tree_reconstruction: Uses source PR blob objects for reviewed code/test files; new audit/handoff blobs are based on current main 60aef00405f26badabd4ac15807df163756204cc.

limitations: Removing files from the current tree does not erase historical Git objects, forks, caches or external copies.
Individual brain-corpus record sensitivity remains unclassified; no record content was inspected.
Disabling Scheduler Tick pauses pending queue execution.
Cross Analysis outputs become bounded workflow artifacts, not a permanent private archive; artifact access/visibility must be treated as repository-accessible.
Administrative branch-protection and required-check enforcement remain unverified; previous administrative endpoint access returned 403.
Workflow action references remain tag-based rather than commit-SHA pinned.
Regression tests assert workflow safety invariants but do not replace a protected-environment approval policy or independent workflow review.
